question: When are these released and when do they bind?
premises: These are in the pervasive state.
They may be together with mind.
Somewhere in an object, from obstruction, they are for bondage.
inference: Release occurs in the pervasive state with mind; bondage occurs in an object through obstruction.
uncertainties: The exact parsing of syurmanasā is uncertain.
The compound rodhādbandhāya may allow more than one reading.
plain_english: These, when in the pervasive state together with mind, may be released; but those, somewhere in an object, from obstruction, lead to bondage.
